# SeedRnd <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Randomization](Language-Features-Randomization)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SeedRnd:Void seed:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `seed` | In | Int32 | required | The starting value. |

## Description

Restarts the random number generator from a seed. The same seed always gives the same numbers from [Rand](Rand) and [Rnd](Rnd), which is useful for replays and procedurally generated levels. Every program starts with the same seed (4660), so it gets the same random numbers on every run until you use `SeedRnd MilliSecs()` for different ones.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
SeedRnd 42
a = Rand(1, 1000)
SeedRnd 42
b = Rand(1, 1000)
Print a = b
```

```text
1
```
